type Loud<T> = T extends string ? Uppercase<T> : never;
type Capitalized<T> = { [K in keyof T as K extends string ? Capitalize<K> : never]: T[K] };
type BoundedTuple<T extends readonly string[]> = T;
type BoundedObject<T extends { value: string }> = T;
type Wrapped<T> = T extends string ? BoundedTuple<[T]> : never;
type RecordValue<T> = T extends string ? BoundedObject<{value:T}> : never;
type Parenthesized<T> = (T) extends (string) ? Uppercase<T> : never;
type Whole<T> = [T] extends [string] ? Uppercase<T> : never;
type Nested<T> = T extends object ? T extends {name: string} ? BoundedObject<{value:T['name']}> : never : never;
const loud: Loud<'hi'> = 'HI';
const keys: Capitalized<{ value: number }> = { Value: 4 };
const wrapped: Wrapped<'yes'> = ['yes'];
console.log(loud, keys.Value, wrapped[0]);
type LoudNested<T, U> = T extends string ? U extends T ? Uppercase<U> : never : never;
type Holder<T extends { x: string }> = T;
type ObjectNested<T, U> = T extends { x: string } ? U extends T ? Holder<U> : never : never;
type TupleNested<T, U> = T extends readonly string[] ? U extends T ? [...U] : never : never;
type IndexNested<T, U> = T extends { x: string } ? U extends T ? U['x'] : never : never;
type ThreeNested<X, T, U> = X extends string ? T extends X ? U extends T ? Uppercase<U> : never : never : never;
const word: LoudNested<string, 'hello'> = 'HELLO';
const object: ObjectNested<{ x: string }, { x: 'hello' }> = { x: 'hello' };
const tuple: TupleNested<readonly string[], ['a','b']> = ['a','b'];
const index: IndexNested<{ x: string }, { x: 'value' }> = 'value';
const triple: ThreeNested<string, 'a' | 'b', 'a'> = 'A';
console.log(word, object.x, tuple, index, triple);
